page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin, beside the first three lines of the second paragraph, one marginal note.

main_text.p: viduos à latere comites esse cupit relinquentes, ad ludicra mundi spectacula dilabamur, & sic eo præmio quod ministris suis & clientibus promisit privemur: inserviamus ipsi, in eo, in quo gratissimum esse poterit nostrum officium; inobedientes ad prudentiam justorum adducamus, ut paremus Domino plebem perfectam, cum fide, tum charitate conspicuam. Id si fideliter administraverimus bonum nobis in futurum gradum, multamque in fide confidentiam acquiremus.

Quibus igitur monstrarit Dominus, Vt sibi recon-dant thesau-ros in cœlu.quo agro thesaurus maximæ felicitatis ipsi lateat, eò properantes, fodiant, scrutentur illum, ut momentaneo labore se in æternum ditent: mittant salvatas infidelium animas, in sinum Abrahæ, ut eos suo tempore, ex promisso Christi, recipiant in cœlestia tabernacula. Lucremur nobis dum tempus est, dulce illud Christi elogium, Sitivi & dedistis mihi bibere, famelicus fui & cibastis me, in carcere eram & visitastis me. Visitemus fratres parvulos istos, in carcere tenebrarum vinctos, annunciantes solutionem compeditis, libertatem incarceratis, & alienatis à vita Dei, annum acceptabilem Domino: sic nos benignus Dei oculus, in die illo ma-

page.notes: The marginal note "Vt sibi recondant thesauros in cœlu." is set in italic. The final letter of "cœlu" is hard to read and may be "cœlo". The word "gno" at the foot right is the catchword, and the text ends on "ma-" as printed. The mark "j" at the bottom left is faint and is read as a signature; it may be a stain. Scripture quotation "Sitivi & dedistis" is printed as "dediftis" and is given as "dedistis" (long s normalised). No other doubtful readings.
